subject.title: I updated Scrapling and the skill became hidden again

question: Should the current Scrapling hide be restored as a scanner false positive, retained as an intentional policy or account hold, or treated as a failure to preserve the previous clean version?
rationale: The public failure is reproducible, but only private scanner, audit, account, and override records can determine whether restoring the listing is safe and consistent with policy.

options.title: Review and restore
options.body: Inspect production records and restore the previous clean listing if the new update is the only artifact under review.

options.title: Retain the hold
options.body: Keep the whole skill hidden if independent policy or account evidence requires it, and explain that outcome to the publisher.

options.title: Open a focused regression fix
options.body: Patch the specific transition or public route if production shows that the existing clean-version fallback was skipped.

recommendation.title: Review and restore
recommendation.body: Inspect production records and restore the previous clean listing if the new update is the only artifact under review.

likelyOwner.reason: He handled the prior Scrapling restoration and has direct operational and policy context for this recurring scanner classification.
